title: Fourier weight above a degree threshold
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers and let $f:(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n\to\mathbb{R}$. The Fourier weight of $f$ above degree $k$ is the sum of the squares of its vector Fourier coefficients over all $\gamma\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$ whose support has cardinality strictly greater than $k$.
